players.name: Jack Strand
players.summary: Strand (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against the Packers.

players.name: Cooper Rush
players.summary: Rush (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game versus Green Bay but will serve as the emergency quarterback.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.summary: Flowers (hamstring) is expected to "test his injury" prior to Sunday's game against the Cowboys, and if he suits up he "will likely be on a pitch count," Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Keon Coleman
players.summary: Coleman (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Chargers.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.summary: Head coach Joe Brady said Friday that Moore (shoulder) will be listed as questionable and a game-time decision for Sunday's contest against the Chargers, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News reports.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.summary: Coker (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Cleveland, Steve Reed of the Associated Press reports.

players.name: Xavier Legette
players.summary: Legette (knee) was listed as a non-participant at Thursday's practice.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.summary: Brooks is expected to undergo surgery Wednesday to repair a core-muscle injury and is likely to miss at least six weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Tyson Bagent
players.summary: Bagent (concussion) didn't take part in practice Friday.

players.name: Caleb Williams
players.summary: Williams (hamstring) was a non-participant at Friday's practice.

players.name: Andrei Iosivas
players.summary: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said Wednesday that Iosivas tore a ligament in his thumb and will be placed on injured reserve, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
players.summary: Mims (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.summary: Coleman (ankle) returned to practice Friday, Zac Stevens of DNVR Sports reports.

players.name: Jayden Reed
players.summary: inactive

players.name: Nico Collins
players.summary: Collins (hamstring) is "very much in doubt" for Sunday's game against the Colts, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.summary: ir

players.name: Ashton Dulin
players.summary: Dulin (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

players.name: Aidan O'Connell
players.summary: O'Connell (personal) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.summary: Bowers (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, with head coach Klint Kubiak telling reporters that the tight end's absence from Friday's practice was planned, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Trey Lance
players.summary: Lance was a limited participant in Friday's practice due to a groin injury and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bills.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.summary: Thompson (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills.

players.name: David Njoku
players.summary: The Chargers placed Njoku (fibula) on injured reserve Wednesday.

players.name: Charlie Kolar
players.summary: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said Wednesday that Kolar (forearm) won't play Sunday in Buffalo but is expected to avoid placement on injured reserve, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Colby Parkinson
players.summary: Parkinson (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's contest at Denver, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.summary: Coach Sean McVay said Friday that Nacua (hip) will be listed as doubtful for Sunday's game at Denver, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

players.name: Ronnie Rivers
players.summary: The Rams placed Rivers (calf) on their injured reserve list Wednesday.

players.name: Ryan Miller
players.summary: Miller (hip) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

players.name: Jaylen Wright
players.summary: Wright (foot) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.summary: Douglas (ankle) didn't practice Thursday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Eli Raridon
players.summary: Raridon (thigh) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

players.name: Barion Brown
players.summary: Brown (hamstring) is listed as out for Sunday's game versus Las Vegas.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.summary: The Giants officially placed Dart (knee) on injured reserve Thursday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Kene Nwangwu
players.summary: Nwangwu (back) is doubtful for Sunday's game against the Lions, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

players.name: Mason Taylor
players.summary: Taylor (thumb) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Detroit.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.summary: Mitchell (finger) will be limited in Friday's practice.

players.name: Arian Smith
players.summary: Smith (knee) underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

players.name: Hollywood Brown
players.summary: Brown (ankle) did not participate in Friday's practice.

players.name: Will Shipley
players.summary: Shipley (foot) was a limited participant in Friday's practice.

players.name: Tank Bigsby
players.summary: Bigsby (abdomen) was limited at practice Friday.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.summary: Goedert (knee) didn't practice Friday.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.summary: Smith (hamstring) practiced in a limited capacity Friday.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.summary: Pittman (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game, according to Alan Saunders of Steelers Now.

players.name: Jaylen Warren
players.summary: Warren (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals after being a limited participant in Friday's practice, Alan Saunders of Steelers Now reports.

players.name: Rico Dowdle
players.summary: Dowdle (toe) was not spotted during the open viewing window of Friday's practice, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.summary: Evans (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Cardinals, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

players.name: Demarcus Robinson
players.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Robinson is facing a recovery timeline of 3-to-6 weeks after sustaining a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Sunday that he's not viewing Aiyuk as an option for the 49ers while the club contends with multiple injuries at receiver, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Charbonnet (knee) returning to practice next week is potentially "on the table," Corbin Smith of SI.com reports.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.summary: Spears (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.summary: Okonkwo (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's contest against the Seahawks.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.summary: Daniels (elbow) won't be placed on injured reserve and is considered week-to-week, per Commanders head coach Dan Quinn.
